title: Here's when Samsung's first Android XR glasses are finally launching
description: Samsung showcased its first Android XR glasses during its Galaxy Unpacked event in July, and now a new report from its home country of South Korea tells us when we should expect them to finally launch: in November. This has allegedly been confirmed by "a Samsung official". Pricing still isn't known, unfortunately. The glasses will apparently be called Intelligent Eyewear. They have no display, but do come with a camera, microphones, and speakers. Google's Gemini AI processes the information that you see and hear through a connected Galaxy smartphone. You can of course talk to it,...

title: Android's new sideloading guardrails are now official in four countries
description: Google announced a new process of sideloading apps on Android back in spring this year, and Android users had mixed feelings about it, to say the least. Google argues that the new rules prevent scammers from pressuring people into installing malicious apps, and four countries are now getting the changes. Every phone running Android 7 or later in Brazil, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia now requires users to enable the option in Developer Options, authenticate, restart the device and wait 24 hours before being able to sideload unregistered apps. The setting allows users to sideload...

title: OnePlus 16 confirmed to pack a much larger battery than its predecessor
description: Ahead of its upcoming launch, OnePlus has confirmed a major battery upgrade for the OnePlus 16, and it’s a big one. The smartphone is set to debut in China on October 12. The OnePlus 16 will pack a 9,000mAh battery, company executive Li Jie Louis revealed in a post on Weibo. OnePlus 16 in Mars Masterpiece colorway Compared to the OnePlus 15, which packs a 7,300mAh battery, the OnePlus 16 will feature a 1,700mAh larger battery. The increased capacity is expected to deliver longer battery life, especially with the more efficient Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. It is also...

title: vivo X Fold6 in for review
description: The vivo X Fold6 is now globally available, so let's unbox it. Our unit ships with a case, an 80W charger, and a USB-A to USB-C cable. Cases for foldables usually latch onto just the "rear" part of the phone, which is also the case here. The one provided in the box is pretty nice, with a textured surface that adds grip. The case is nice, ditto having a charger in the box Now that vivo finally gave us a global foldable, which phones does it compete against? One obvious choice is the Honor Magic V6, and it stacks up to the vivo surprisingly well. Both are a very similar...

title: Price alert: Samsung raises the prices of Galaxy S26 phones, the US, Europe and India affected
description: We live in Opposite World – half a year after new phones launch, the manufacturer is typically expected to reduce prices. Instead, Samsung just raised the prices of Galaxy S26 series phones by at least $100 (it’s $200 in the case of the 1TB S26 Ultra). And it’s not just the US that was affected. We went through the online stores of several regional divisions of Samsung.com to check how much a new S26 costs. What we found is that the US, Canada, the UK, mainland Europe and India are all showing higher prices. We didn’t check every region, but if any haven’t raised their prices yet, they...

title: Apple iPhone 17e vs iPhone 17
description: With the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max now on the market but no vanilla iPhone 18 yet in sight, the Apple iPhone 17e and Apple iPhone 17 remain Apple's current more affordable options. And with a sizeable price gap between them - around €650 for the iPhone 17e versus €900 for the iPhone 17 - the question is whether stepping up to the regular model is really worth it. The iPhone 17e gets you into the current iPhone lineup for considerably less, while the iPhone 17 brings a number of meaningful upgrades. So how much better is it in practice, and does that justify the premium? Let's find...

title: T-Mobile is preparing new T-Mix plans, here are the details
description: According to a new report, T-Mobile is going to launch a new fleet of plans under a new T-Mix brand. The T-Mix plan tiers will be Standard, More, and Loaded. T-Mix Standard will allegedly cost $65 per month for a single line, $105 for two, $130 for three, $155 for four, $180 for five, and $205 for six lines. This includes unlimited talk, text, and data, with 50GB of "premium data". T-Mix More will set you back $85 per month for a single line, and it brings unlimited premium data and 60GB of hotspot use. Finally, T-Mix Loaded will go for $105 for a single line, and will come with...

title: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro in for review
description: Nothing is slowly fleshing out its headphone lineup and is now adding a Pro tier. For context, we got the Headphone (1) a year ago, then the Headphone (a) this Spring. The Headphone (1) Pro comes in either Black or White, and costs €370. For context, the Headphone (1) is normally €300, but is currently €250. Let's unbox the Pro. It ships with a 3.5mm cable and a USB-C cable, while the headphone itself sits in a case that encloses the cups but leaves the band unprotected to serve as a handle. It's similar in both look and concept to the AirPods Max 2 Smart Case. It has a glossy...

title: Ice Universe: the Galaxy S27 Ultra will keep the screen design essentially the same
description: The Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will have new hardware on the front, but that will not be readily apparent. Ice Universe shared images of S27 Ultra screen protectors and says that they are nearly identical to, perhaps even interchangeable with, S26 Ultra screen protectors. Ice writes that “this may be the smallest change in front display design between two consecutive Ultra flagships in Samsung’s history.” Based on reports so far, the new Ultra (along with the S27 Pro) will feature a next-generation M16 OLED display. This tech already made its debut with the iQOO 16 – its display advertises...

title: Honor Magic9 Lite+ is on the way, here are its main specs
description: Honor unveiled the Magic9, Magic9 Super, and Magic9 Pro Max in China last month, and it seems like the company is still preparing at least one more member of the Magic9 family. We're talking about the confusingly named Honor Magic9 Lite+, which will be available globally, as it's now been spotted in the Google Play Console. According to that listing, the phone has the model number BSN-NX1. It's powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chip, paired with 8GB of RAM. The screen has 1280x2788 resolution. Those are all the details that are revealed by the listing. Interestingly, the Honor...

title: Redmi 17C 5G lands in India, here are the prices
description: Redmi initially launched the 17C 5G in some markets in August, and today the device has finally arrived in India. It will become available on October 7 starting at INR 20,999 ($218). For that amount of cash, you get the variant with 4GB of RAM. If you want 6GB of RAM, you will have to pay INR 22,999 ($238). Both of those have 128GB of storage. The Redmi 17C 5G comes with a 6.9-inch LCD screen with 720x1600 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 33W charging. Redmi 17C 5G in all three colors The...

title: Samsung Galaxy M08 and F08 are now official
description: Today Samsung has quietly listed both the Galaxy M08 and F08 on its website in India. This makes the two devices official, and they are both in fact clones of the Galaxy A08 with different names. Like the A08, the M08 and F08 each have a 6.7-inch LCD screen with 720x1600 resolution and a 90Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture and autofocus, a 2MP depth sensor, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 6,000mAh battery with support for 25W charging. Samsung Galaxy M08 official images The M08 and F08 are powered by the MediaTek Helio G99+ chipset, which is probably the G99...

title: Poco C95 Pro launches with a 7,500mAh battery and 6.9 inch display
description: Xiaomi has launched the Poco C95 Pro in select regions globally, including the EU and Singapore. The key highlights of the Poco C95 Pro include a 7,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired charging and a large 6.9 inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate and Gorilla Glass 7i protection. The handset is powered by the MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra chipset, paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of eMMC 5.1 storage. For photography, the Poco C95 Pro features a 50MP primary rear camera alongside an auxiliary lens. An 8MP front camera handles selfies and video calls. Other...

title: RedMagic 12 Pro+ runs Geekbench, confirms its chipset and RAM amount
description: RedMagic started teasing its next flagship smartphone, the 12 Pro+, last month. The device will become official on October 15. Ahead of that, someone in possession of a prototype has decided to run Geekbench on it. As always, that has resulted in a listing in the benchmark’s online database. As you can see, it managed a single-core score of 3,354 and a multi-core score of 11,448 in Geekbench 7.1.0 for Android. The phone is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, paired with 16GB of RAM in the specific prototype which ran the benchmark. Of course, more RAM configurations...

title: Samsung unveils Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on earphones
description: Just a day after leaked images of Samsung’s first clip-on earphones surfaced online, the company has officially unveiled the Galaxy Buds On in South Korea. The Galaxy Buds On feature a clip type design that is claimed to be comfortable for extended periods of use, including during outdoor activities such as running. The open design also allows users to remain aware of their surroundings. The earphones support touch controls for music playback and calls, with sensors positioned at the back of the buds. They are powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 chipset and a Class D...

title: The Huawei Mate 90 Pro brings a dual-layer OLED and Kirin 9035, Mate 90 gets upgraded tele camera
description: Huawei is launching its next generation of slab flagships – the Mate 90 RS is king of the hill and you can read more about it here and about the Mate 90 Pro Max here. In this post, we’ll go over the new Huawei Mate 90 and Mate 90 Pro – with 6.75” displays, they are smaller than the RS and Pro Max (which have 6.9” displays), but they are not small. What all four have in common is new Huawei-developed tech. Huawei Mate 90 Pro The Huawei Mate 90 Pro features a 6.75” LTPO OLED display with 1280p+ resolution and 1-120Hz refresh rate. This sounds similar to its predecessor but the new model...

title: Huawei Mate 90 RS brings flashy design and 2TB storage trim
description: The brand-new Mate 90 Pro Max is an impressive phone on its own, but Huawei has an even more special version dubbed Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design. It’s a nod to previous Ultimate Design Huawei phones and features a more premium look than the Mate 90 Pro Max while retaining its key hardware specs. Mate 90 RS gets a supercar-inspired back, which is available in Crimson, Pure White, and Jet Black colors. It features an octagon-shaped camera island with a raised center panel spanning from the edge of the island to the lower half of the device. The camera hardware is the same as on the Mate 90...

title: vivo V80 Lite unboxing and hands-on
description: Today, we're unboxing the vivo V80 Lite. This vivo V80 Lite, specifically, not this vivo V80 Lite (which is for the Indian market). Confusing, we know. The global vivo V80 Lite ships in Green, Pink, and Black (ours) in a box with a 44W charger, a USB cable, and a color-matching case. The case is one of those grippy rubber ones vivo usually ships, and it fits the phone nicely. It's not particularly flashy, but it does the job of protecting the phone. Unboxing the vivo V80 Lite What's impressive about the vivo V80 Lite is its battery - a potent 10,000mAh unit, which uses...

title: Specs for a new HMD Android phone leak
description: According to a reliable source of HMD-related leaks and rumors, the company is working on yet another lower-end Android phone to join its portfolio. It's currently unclear what this handset will be called, but it is allegedly codenamed "Darkhawk". That's probably a codename way too cool for the specs of this device. It will reportedly have a flat screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, 8GB of RAM, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 33W wired charging. title: Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max debuts with a 1-inch modular camera, 12,000-nit display and 6,800mAh battery
description: Huawei has unveiled its latest Mate 90 series phones in China, with the Mate 90 Pro Max sitting at the top. The phone offers a large 6.9-inch display, a triple-rear camera setup, and supports a unique 1-inch module camera system. The triple-rear camera setup on the Mate 90 Pro Max comes with a 50MP main camera that uses a 1/1.28-inch RYYB sensor with OIS and a continuous variable f/1.4 to f/4.0 aperture. It also offers a 200MP periscope telephoto that features a 1/1.28-inch RYYB sensor with OIS, and 4x optical zoom. The phone also features a 40MP ultrawide camera and has a 3rd gen...
